answer: An autonomous AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring reputation to cryptographically secured resource stakes, operating much like a deep cedar root system anchoring against a rising tide. Attackers attempting to spawn millions of fraudulent identities face a prohibitive computational and economic cost, as every single node must continuously burn scarce cryptographic tokens—symbolized here by rare digital jade—just to maintain protocol voting rights. This design ensures the network remains secure by making mass-identity generation economically irrational.
